detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

I rebuilt my old n8n stack as a clean Docker Compose project. Ollama and Whisper stay on the internal Docker network with no published ports, and a custom n8n image adds FFmpeg and yt-dlp for video work. I also go through the two workflows I used it for, a daily AI news digest and a video-to-article pipeline. Do note that Execute Command can run anything, so validate input before it gets there.

https://techhut.tv/local-ai-automation-n8n-ollama-whisper

#n8n #SelfHosted #LocalAI
